name: h3-node
description: H3 Bindings to node using N-API

scripts.install: bash -c "if node-gyp-build-test; then node-gyp-build; else npm run prebuild && node-gyp-build; fi"
scripts.clean: node-gyp clean && node -e "for (const d of ['h3', 'build']) { require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }) }"
scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/index.js test/types-coverage.js && npm run test:types
